high_level_description: The image depicts a woman leaving the Aman hotel, presumably ahead of her wedding to Bezos on Friday. She is dressed in an elegant white tailored Dior skirt suit and is accessorized with Tom Ford sunglasses. The woman is waving with her right hand, indicating she might be acknowledging someone or greeting those around her. The setting appears to be outdoors, possibly near the entrance of the hotel, as suggested by the presence of curtains tied back to reveal a dark background. There are two men in the foreground; one is wearing a white cap and the other is dressed in a black suit.
